heading: **28 January 2026**
body:
*ELF Nucleosome dilution to 100 mM salt*

| Component | Stock | Final | Volume for 50 mL |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Tris pH 8** | **1 M** | **15 mM** | **0.75 mL (750 µL)** |
| **EDTA** | **0.5 M** | **1 mM** | **0.10 mL (100 µL)** |
| **EGTA** | **0.5 M** | **0.5 mM** | **0.05 mL (50 µL)** |
| **KCl** | **4 M** | **100 mM** | **1.25 mL** |
| **TCEP** | **(your stock)** | **same v/v as before** | **0.50 mL (500 µL)** |
| **Glycerol** | **100%** | **5% v/v** | **2.50 mL** |
| **Nuclease-free water** | **—** | **—** | **to 50.00 mL** |

Once reconstitution is completed → perform two rounds of dialysis (by changing buffer once) → first round for about 2-3 hours → buffer change → overnight dialysis

Now the nucleosomes will be at 100 mM salt. Estimate the overall concentration of DNA/nucleosomes at this point with Qubit.

*Ligation Round 2*

Take the ligated lig147 and N40 HTFS samples.

Set up reaction with:

10% PEG4000 → 3 uL 50% PEG4000

0.5 mM CoHex → 0.75 uL 10 mM CoHex

1.5 uL T4 DNA ligase buffer

1.5 uL T4 DNA ligase

8.25 uL ligation round 1 product

Incubate 1-2 hours, RT → 16 C, O/N

*Proteinase K treatment \+ Ligation*

Take 1000 ng of PNK-treated DNA \+ 0.4 uL Proteinase K \+ 0.2 uL 10% SDS → Make up volume to 20 uL → Incubate 15 mins, RT → Column purify.

From the purified DNA, set up all in a ligation reaction with 0.5 uL CoHex & 2 uL 50% PEG4000 in a total of 10 uL volume. Ligate at RT, 1-2 hours → 16 C, O/N.
title: ELF Nucleosome dilution to 100 mM salt
